title: Working on a voxel system for my dungeon core!
author: jocktor
selftext:
[Larger view \(no textures\)](https://preview.redd.it/3w4z9qlgxikh1.png?width=1142&format=png&auto=webp&s=03c9ca0052d478de246668c23ca58e690e9682ee)

[Soft surface voxels let us edit and modify the smoothness of the surface.](https://preview.redd.it/y1fhg7njxikh1.png?width=903&format=png&auto=webp&s=85d3f6f8e7531810e670d180ed004c62c6a23cd7)

Learning and deving as we go, but really love the sculpting of the tech!

https://preview.redd.it/oguif21vxikh1.png?width=912&format=png&auto=webp&s=1a3f2650fcba65c601d11c3c51a55aa72351a099

As you shape your world, the creatures and the multiple heroes that you will build up. Really loving the project and the tech developing behind it.

Godot with C++ GD extension for the voxel.

Any thoughts, tips, advice or shares are welcome. Trolls invites XD

(note also got post removed for "ai" use in https://www.reddit.com/r/VoxelGameDev/)

comments.author: GeraniumCloak
comments.body: ngl the smooth surface editing looks clean. you doing marching cubes or dual contouring? gdextension is the right call for voxel perf either way

comments.author: jocktor
comments.body:
It is voxel but i enable the surfaces voxels to have their surface voxels to be edited

Treating it like a vector plain, still meshed together.

So little extra height data on surface voxels. Worth it imo.

replies.author: jocktor
replies.body:
Editable and sculptable in real time by players. So you can make shelves or slopes, or decorarive embelishmemts to buildings.

It's pretty sick tbh.
